text:
maria: noticed unusual IAM grant on our KMS key `projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/main/cryptoKeys/key1` — principal partner-int-svc@partner was given encrypter/decrypter yesterday 21:10 UTC. audit shows a direct iam.bind action.
oliver: that's unexpected. partner onboarding runs were last week. any terraform or human change logged?
ash: pulling the admin audit entry now, attaching snippet.

maria: log snippet pasted:
```
{"protoPayload":{"methodName":"google.iam.v1.IAM.BindRole","principalEmail":"partner-int-svc@partner","resourceName":"projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/main/cryptoKeys/key1","request":{"role":"roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter"}},"timestamp":"2026-03-12T21:10:12Z"}
```
ash: that role allows decrypt/unwrapping; if partner svc can unwrap, anything encrypted with key1 is at risk.
rotor-bot: [automated] anomaly detected: cross-project KMS grant outside usual vendor patterns. Recommended immediate containment: snapshot key metadata, revoke suspicious grant, and escalate to oncall.
sam: containment checklist: 1) snapshot usage metrics and list wrapped blobs 2) create emergency SA for rewrap ops 3) revoke partner grant 4) rewrap data to new key 5) rotate downstream secrets.
devops-oncall: agree with staged approach. full revoke may break jobs. propose maintenance window in 10m for canary revoke + smoke tests.
jen: FYI some Vault transit mount uses a KMS-wrapped key alias referencing key1 for encrypting database credentials — need to identify which mounts.
oliver: quick asset enumeration:
```
gcloud asset search-all-resources --scope=projects/prod --query="cryptoKeys/name:key1" --format=json
```
maria: results: vault-transit-alias, logs-bucket-prod, backups-bucket-2025, func-auth-service and analytics-worker.
ash: request to partner: did you initiate an IAM change? Partner answers: "we ran a sync but didn't modify roles." sounds dubious.
rotor-bot: created incident INC-2026-0484: kms-crossproject-grant. Paging SRE and Vendor Sec.
maria: executing staged revoke: 1) grant temporary rewrap SA to our ops team 2) revoke partner-int-svc binding 3) run rewrap on discovered resources 4) rotate service tokens.
sam: rewrap plan ready. using parallel workers with rate limit to avoid KMS quota issues. Can someone run the rewrap script with rotated key `key1-2026-03-12`?
ash: running rewrap command:
```
python infra/rewrap.py --source-key key1 --dest-key key1-2026-03-12 --resources-file ./key1-assets.json --workers 6
```
maria: revoke performed at 4387660060. monitoring for errors.
devops-oncall: minor job failures observed in one cloud function, rolling restart fixed it.
sam: canary rotations and smoke tests passed for auth service and vault transit mount.
jen: validated Vault unwrappers — no unexpected unwraps from partner principals after revoke.
oliver: note to update alerts: add rule for cross-project KMS grants + notify VendorSec channel.
maria: action items: @ash extract full 30d audit for key1, @oliver enumerate all CMEK dependencies and file PR to tighten IAM conditions for vendor grants, @sam produce token rotation runbook and list affected apps, @devops-oncall coordinate a full rewrap window tomorrow for any remaining resources.
ash: uploaded audit export: https://logs.internal.company/exports/key1-438765.json :lock:
rotor-bot: [automated] increased KMS audit log retention to 90 days for project prod.
maria: leaving this thread as the coordination point. will follow up with a concise blameless postmortem and vendor onboarding checklist update. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
